description: This Java source file defines the OptionsValueController class, which manages HTTP requests related to product option values in an e-commerce admin panel. It provides functionalities such as listing, editing, creating, saving, deleting, and removing images for product option values.

classes.name: OptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations for product option values in the admin interface, including image management and pagination.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the list of product options values page.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific product option value.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a product option value.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles form submission to create or update a product option value, including validation and image upload.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Provides a JSON response with a paginated list of product option values for the frontend, supporting search by name.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Deletes a specific product option value via AJAX.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Removes the image associated with a product option value.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu structure for the admin UI pages.
